# 3 bed terraced house for sale

> BRANT & CO Property Consultants are delighted to present 47 Chapel Lane, Swords, Co. Dublin to the market. Situated in a mature and highly convenient residential location just a stone’s throw from Swords Village, No. 47 is a bright and well-proportioned three-bedroom mid-terrace home extending to approximately 79.4 sq. m. (855 sq. ft.).
